title: The Evergreen Velvet Holiday Party Outfit
description: Evergreen Velvet Holiday Party Outfit from Walmart: Free Assembly High Break Velvet Blazer, Secret Treasures Satin Midi Slip Dress, Pennysue Pointed Toe Short Heels, Cate & Chloe Corina 20mm Crystal Hoops.
intro: Holiday party season and I refuse to buy a whole new wardrobe for it. A deep evergreen velvet blazer over an emerald satin slip dress, silver glitter pointed heels, crystal hoops and a little silver clutch. It looks expensive, it is not, and the blazer goes with jeans the whole rest of winter.
